This position serves a critical role at the South Florida Natural Resouces Center (SFNRC) within Everglades National Park, serving in the following roles: Directs the financial planning development efforts for the SFNRC and oversees and tracks SFNRC expenditures by serving as liaison between SFNRC staff and the Director.

Plans, develops, coordinates, and implements Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and processes for all aspects of the SFNRC administrative activities. This duty requires interpretation of various federal administrative policies to make sure that the developed SOPs to facilitate the work of the SFNRC are compatible with agency and unit policies.

Directs all SFNRC procurement activities needed to acquire supplies, equipment, materials, and service contracts while assuring work is done through proper sources, with appropriate documentation and justifications.

Directs the preparation and tracking of all contracts and assistance agreements needed by the SFNRC and works closely with the Major Acquisition Buying Office during all phases.

Directs the human resources function for the SFNRC, providing specific guidance on personnel matters for the SFNRC management team and staff while implementing initiatives to foster a positive work environment and promote collaboration among staff.

Directly supervises management analysts and administrative support assistants while directly working with a budget analyst.
Requirements Continued... You may be required to travel overnight away from home occasionally. You must obtain a government charge card for travel purposes. You may be required to complete training and obtain/maintain a government charge card with travel and/or purchase authority.

All qualifications must be met by the closing date of this announcement-08/05/2026-unless otherwise stated in this vacancy announcement. Credit will be given for all appropriate qualifying experience.

For current Federal employees, if hours worked per week are not included on your resume, you must submit a non-award SF-50 for each federal position listed as part of your application to be used to validate your work schedule and determine the amount of qualifying experience that you will be granted.

An award SF-50 will not be acceptable documentation for which to consider your amount of qualifying experience. For all other applicants who are not current federal employees, your resume must state either "full-time" (or "40 hours a week") or "part-time" with the number of hours worked per week to ensure proper crediting of specialized experience.

Failure to adequately provide information needed to determine number of hours worked in each position may result in that time not being credited when evaluating qualifying experience.

For periods of time that reflect military service, the DD-214 or Statement of Service is sufficient to meet the full and/or part-time hours requirement as the service dates will be reflected.

EXPERIENCE: At least one full year of specialized experience comparable in scope and responsibility to the GS-11 grade level in the Federal service (obtained in either the public or private sectors).

This experience includes activities such as: Budget and financial management of a large organization; Development of standard operating and administrative procedures for a large organization; Advisory and human resources liaison roles to management; Acquisition and procurement (contracting and purchasing) and assistance agreements; or facilities management.

Your resume must include hours worked per week or you will not be given credit for any specialized experieince and will be found not qualified.

Volunteer Experience: Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

As the Manager, Quality Assurance within Customer Support, you will play a key role in shaping how we measure, maintain, and improve the quality of our customer experience across every support interaction.

You’ll lead the evolution of our QA program, helping define the frameworks, processes, and operational strategies that enable our teams to deliver consistent, high-quality support at scale.

By leveraging AI-powered QA tooling, you’ll surface actionable insights, identify emerging themes, and help drive continuous improvements in support quality and team performance.
Our QA program is still in its early stages, with foundational processes already in place but significant opportunity to iterate, expand, and mature the function over time. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in evolving environments and is excited by the opportunity to help shape a modern QA program while balancing strategic ownership with hands-on execution.
Reporting into Customer Support leadership, you will partner closely with Support Operations, frontline leaders, Enablement, Product, and other cross-functional teams to identify opportunities for operational improvement, coaching, and quality enhancements across the customer journey. You’ll help establish scalable QA methodologies, calibration practices, reporting structures, and feedback loops that drive accountability and continuous improvement throughout the organization.
In this role, you’ll also help shape how QA supports AI-powered customer experiences. As AI-assisted workflows and responses continue to evolve, you’ll evaluate both human and AI-generated customer interactions to ensure quality, consistency, accuracy, and alignment with the customer experience we aim to deliver. Your ability to identify trends, uncover friction points, and drive targeted quality initiatives will directly influence both team effectiveness and customer experience.
This role has the potential to evolve into direct people leadership of QA specialists or QA team leads as the function grows.
How we’re using AI today
Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster.

AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.
This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

Experience working with AI-enabled support tools and comfort evaluating the effectiveness and quality of AI-assisted customer interactions.
Experience building or deploying AI-driven coaching and enablement solutions that surface performance insights, reinforce quality standards, and help support teams continuously improve at scale.
Hands-on experience with CRM and support platforms such as Zendesk, along with familiarity with QA platforms and AI-enabled support technologies.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience influencing cross-functional stakeholders and aligning teams around operational improvements.
Comfort operating in ambiguity and evolving environments where iteration, adaptability, and problem-solving are essential.
Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution in a rapidly evolving organization.
Located in Atlantic, Eastern or Central timezones (AT, ET or CT).

Define, evolve, and operationalize a centralized quality assurance strategy across customer support channels, including email, chat, messaging, and voice.
Iterate on and maintain QA frameworks, scorecards, audit methodologies, and calibration processes that drive consistency, accountability, and high-quality customer experiences.
Analyze QA results, customer interactions, CSAT trends, and operational performance data to identify coaching opportunities, process improvements, and targeted areas requiring additional QA oversight.
Identify high-impact moments across the customer journey where deeper QA focus is needed, including low CSAT interactions, escalations, complex workflows, or AI-assisted conversations.
Partner with Support Operations and frontline leadership to translate QA insights into actionable recommendations, operational improvements, and ongoing training opportunities.
Evaluate both team member and AI-generated customer interactions to ensure responses are accurate, effective, compliant, and aligned with quality standards and brand expectations.
Help shape how AI tooling is incorporated into support workflows, using QA insights and performance data to improve customer outcomes and operational efficiency.
Develop reporting, analyses, and presentations that communicate QA performance, trends, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership teams.

Kiavi is one of the nation’s largest private lenders to residential real estate investors (REIs). We harness the power of data & technology to offer our customers a simpler, more reliable, and faster way to access the capital they need to scale their businesses.

Formerly known as LendingHome, we’re committed to helping REIs revitalize the approximately $25 trillion worth of aged U.S. housing stock to provide move-in ready homes and rental housing for millions of Americans across the country.

Combining our technology and industry expertise, Kiavi has grown to a team of over 500 and has won many awards over the years including Forbes Fintech 50, Finovate Awards, Best Digital Mortgage Platform, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and many more.

Loans Funded: $30 billion in loans funded

Homes financed: 100,000+ projects funded for our customers across the country

Geography: 49 states + D.C. where we lend to REIs so they can revitalize neighborhoods

Employees: Over 500 employees with competitive benefits and perks
This position can be based remotely in any of our approved hiring regions. Our hybrid distributed workforce philosophy allows us to find the best talent in the country and build diverse teams, while allowing our colleagues to work from the location that works best for them.

Identity Verification Notice: To ensure the security and integrity of our hiring process, all candidates are required to complete a secure identity verification. This process uses biometric and device validation to confirm identity and liveness. All data is handled securely in accordance with our privacy policy.

The Role The Kiavi Customer Experience organization is rooted in three core principles ; Doing the Right Thing, Commitment to Excellence and Winning as a Team. Each teammate centers their work around trying to make a difference in the lives of each and every customer daily - through helping them successfully secure financing and grow their business.

Kiavi is seeking an experienced relationship manager who thrives in serving customers to maximize their potential. This person should thrive in chaos, Successful candidates should possess the ability to organize competing priorities and tasks, be a self starter, result-oriented, and when in doubt always do right by the customer.

You will be responsible for delivering a best-in-class customer experience while ensuring Kiavi is the selected partner for customer's current and future projects and needs.

Through our commitment to service and best-in-class technology, you will be responsible for acquiring, retaining and growing your customers’ business with Kiavi and demonstrating why Kiavi is the best partner to serve their mortgage needs. Responsibilities
Proactively build your borrower “book of business” - comprised of passionate real estate investors looking to grow their own businesses
Operate as “Champion of the Customer” for all borrower needs
Engage and support your clients’ needs - on their timetables - including occasional weekend and evening coverage
Advise borrowers throughout the origination experience - particularly as it relates to pricing, valuation, rehab project scope-of-work
Attend local and regional industry events - including REA meetings and conference
Delivering a complete loan application file ready for underwriting
Driving higher repeat business to produce incremental growth to each borrower relationship
Contribute to projects that improve the business and effectiveness of the team
Partnering with your customers to qualify for the right mortgage for their situation, obtain required documentation, and guide them through the application process
Operate as the champion for any and all matters specific to your customers
Build and maintain strong, long-lasting customer relationships as the result of being a trusted advisor
Ensure the timely and successful delivery of our solutions according to customer needs and objectives
Deliver and own communication for material updates (e.g. new state licensing, new product, process changes, credit policy)
Work cross functionally with the Operations team to help resolve and mitigate any customer or loan issues
Support and empower to your teammates in order to win as a team

CRM or Salesforce experience
College degree in Business, Marketing, Finance, or relevant experience
Passion for Real Estate investing
Excellent listening, negotiation, and presentation skills
Set high standards for yourself matched with exceptional interpersonal skills
Ability to adapt in a dynamic and growing organization
High empathy and desire to help others
Experience in formulating and presenting solutions based on customer needs
Proven ability to manage multiple projects at a time while demonstrating strong attention to detail
Kiavi takes a market-based approach to pay, and pay may vary depending on your location. The expected annualized base pay range for this full-time role to be performed remotely is $40,000 to $60,000 + $3,000 bonus + benefits. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries.

Within the range, the successful candidate’s starting pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Your recruiter can share more about the specific base pay range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

Please note that the pay range listed above reflects the base salary only, and does not include the target value of bonus or benefits. Benefits and Perks

Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance: Kiavi offers free employee-only coverage for medical, dental, and vision plans. Dependents receive a heavily discounted premium, competitively placed in the 90th percentile for cost.

Health Savings Account (HSA): For those enrolled in a High Deductible Health Plan (HDHP), Kiavi provides an annual employer contribution to HSAs: $1,000 for individual coverage and $2,000 for dependents.

Disability and Life Insurance: Immediate access to short-term and long-term disability insurance, as well as group life and AD&D insurance, with coverage at 1x annual salary.

Remote Work Policy: Kiavi supports working remotely for day to day activities for most roles and occasionally may ask employees to gather in person for key meetings, training, team building etc. For remote workers, Kiavi offers a one-time office setup reimbursement of up to $500 and a monthly $85 stipend for internet and phone expenses. For in-office workers, Kiavi offers employer contributions to commuter benefits account, either for parking or public transportation.

Flexible Time Off: Employees are empowered to manage their own time off, with no strict limits, as long as it's approved by their manager.

Paid Leaves: Up to 8 weeks of paid leave for medical or caregiver purposes, and 12 weeks of paid maternity/paternity leave. Short-term disability leave is also available for birthing mothers.

401(k) & Company Match: A 401(k) plan managed by Fidelity, with Kiavi matching 100% of contributions up to 3% of compensation or $8,000 (whichever is less). All employer contributions are immediately vested.

This role provides professional support to BMO Partners by assisting with inquiries, account openings, transfers, and ongoing account maintenance. Partner Support & Relationship Management
Acts as the primary point of contact for Financial Planners, Private Bankers, Regional Sales Managers, and Branch Partners, providing timely and accurate support across a range of investment-related services.
Ownership & Follow-Through
Owns and follows up on complex files, making it easy for Partners to do business and inspiring confidence in our processes, service standards, and overall brand.
Customer Needs & Service Excellence

Compliance & Risk Management

Suspicious Activity Reporting

May initiate outbound calls to resolve complex situations and ensure customer satisfaction.

Strong collaboration and team skills.
Analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.

Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most.

We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most .
Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too.
Come do the best work of your life at Boulevard.

Wolt and Roo operate under the DoorDash umbrella, and Customer Support sits at the intersection of brand experience, unit economics and long-term growth. This role owns the strategy on:
Where should we operate support, at what scale, and at what cost, across a rolling multi-year horizon?
How do we architect frontline service design to be AI-ready as frontline tooling evolves, deliver best-in-class customer experience, and remain cost-efficient?
How do we manage our workforce with precision, eliminating waste, consolidating overlapping structures, and continuously improving headcount efficiency through automation and org redesign?
This is a permanent leadership role. The person in this seat will own network strategy, service design and workforce management as a continuous discipline, embedding deeply into Wolt, Roo and DoorDash technology stacks, building and refreshing the financial and operational case for change, and evolving the execution roadmap as the business, technology and market shift.

A. Support Service Design
Own the demand and supply planning, and scheduling for the network, partnering deeply with upstream business owners and defect elimination to enable forecasting accuracy.
Own ongoing assessment of how service is structured and delivered at the frontline across both brands.
Maintain the role architecture map: what roles exist, what they do, where they overlap.
Evaluate how tools (CRM, WFM, knowledge base, AI tools, ticketing) enable or constrain frontline roles, and keep this view current as tooling changes.
Own and evolve the target-state frontline model aligned to AI-augmented ways of working.
Continuously run gap analysis: current state vs. target state, with prioritised interventions.
B. Support Site Strategy
Own the support site footprint across both brands as an ongoing portfolio.
Maintain and refresh strategic site scenarios across cost, quality, risk and scalability as conditions change.
Own the financial model underpinning site strategy: OpEx, CapEx, transition cost, and planning cycles.
Continuously assess BPO vs. in-house mix, nearshore vs. offshore trade-offs, and consolidation opportunities.
Bring forward exec-ready recommendations as circumstances warrant, with clear pros, cons and decision criteria.
Keep the site strategy framed against contact volume reduction through automation.
C. Workforce Management Transformation
Own WFM maturity across both brands on an ongoing basis: demand forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling, real-time management.
Identify and close tooling gaps and duplication across Wolt and Roo WFM stacks.
Own and evolve the consolidated WFM target operating model.

s.h: Own the continuous efficiency case, driven through
s.t:
Org consolidation: merging duplicated WFM roles across the two brands.
Contact automation: defect elimination and end-to-end customer-facing automation.
AI-assisted agent workflows: human-in-the-loop bot interfaces, AI-guided resolution, next-best-action tools.
Scheduling and real-time optimisation via AI/ML tooling.
Own tooling requirements and vendor strategy (shortlists, entries, exits) as an ongoing responsibility.
D. DoorDash Technology Integration
Maintain deep, current working knowledge of DoorDash's support technology stack.
Continuously translate technology capabilities into concrete business levers for the Wolt and Roo context.
Own the dependency map between integration milestones and the Support transformation roadmap.
Flag risks early where integration timelines could affect strategy execution.
E. Execution Planning
Own the rolling execution plan: prioritised initiatives, owners, investment, expected outcomes, refreshed as priorities shift.
Own the forward-looking roadmap: strategic bets, sequencing logic, capability-build requirements.
Own stakeholder alignment across Support Operations, Product, Finance and People functions on an ongoing basis.

Current state visibility: Maintain a living view of service design, site footprint, financial planning cycles and WFM maturity across Wolt & Roo, with an opinionated, forward-looking perspective on where the network needs to go.
DoorDash technology translation: Continuously map DoorDash technology capabilities to Wolt/Roo business levers, tracking upstream product, tooling and integration roadmaps and their implications for network design.
Support site strategy: Maintain a multi-year scenario model with full financial analysis, pros & cons, and a standing recommended path, developed in partnership with the wider Strategy and Operations organisation.
Planning mechanisms: Own and run weekly, monthly, quarterly and annual mechanisms for demand and supply planning (long and short term) and scheduling/real-time management, optimising for customer experience and efficiency, with clear visibility for executive leadership.
WFM transformation: Own the consolidated operating model, tooling spec, and the efficiency case for the organisation, with signed-off financial projections refreshed as the business evolves.
Roadmap ownership: Maintain a rolling forward roadmap covering strategic sequencing, capability investments, and automation maturity milestones, ratified through regular leadership review.
Stakeholder alignment: Keep all key workstream owners briefed, committed and clear on accountabilities on an ongoing basis.
All recommendations must be underpinned by a financial model, and must be decision-ready on first presentation.
Operating Rhythm
Embed & Orient (ongoing as scope evolves): Maintain stakeholder maps; stay immersed in Wolt, Roo & DoorDash systems; keep baseline data current; revisit scope and success criteria as the business changes.
Diagnose: Continuously reassess current state across all workstreams; keep DoorDash tech translation current; surface risks and quick wins as they emerge.
Design & Model: Maintain and evolve site strategy scenarios, the frontline service design blueprint, the WFM target model, and supporting financial models.
Synthesise & Align: Run regular executive forums and stakeholder sign-off cycles.
Roadmap & Continuity: Maintain the forward roadmap; ensure knowledge is embedded across the team rather than concentrated in one person.

Surface operational insights and trends from your live ops work to inform product and process improvement efforts.

Customer Care Associate – Collections, Retention & Sales
Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
Employment Type: Full-Time Contractor
Industry: Retail & E-commerce / Fitness & Wellness
Schedule: Monday–Friday | 9:00 AM–5:30 PM Eastern Time

Our client is a growing fitness, wellness, and technology company focused on making engaging workout experiences accessible through connected fitness products and digital memberships.
The business combines fitness equipment with a technology-driven membership experience that includes live and on-demand workouts, instructor-led classes, personalized training features, entertainment, and multiple workout formats.
Operating at the intersection of fitness, e-commerce, technology, and subscription services , the company places a strong emphasis on creating a positive customer experience throughout the entire relationship—from purchase and membership activation through ongoing support and retention.

We are looking for confident and customer-focused Customer Care Associates who can successfully handle collections, membership retention, customer support, live chat, and sales within the same role.
This is a dynamic position where every customer interaction may be different. One conversation might involve securing a payment commitment from a past-due customer, another may involve helping a member reconsider a cancellation, and another could turn a customer inquiry into a sales opportunity.
You'll communicate primarily through phone and live chat , handle both inbound and outbound interactions, maintain accurate account records, and adapt your approach to each customer's situation.
This opportunity is ideal for someone who is comfortable on the phone, resilient during challenging conversations, commercially minded, and able to balance excellent customer service with measurable business objectives.

Collections & Retention
Make outbound calls to customers with past-due accounts.
Professionally discuss outstanding balances and work to secure clear payment commitments.
Navigate potentially difficult financial conversations with confidence and professionalism.
Contact customers who have requested to cancel their membership.
Understand the reasons behind cancellation requests and use approved retention offers and save strategies when appropriate.
Communicate membership value naturally and persuasively while maintaining a positive customer experience.
Sales & Customer Support
Monitor live chat and respond to customer questions in real time.
Resolve customer issues and provide accurate information.
Identify potential sales and upselling opportunities during customer conversations.
Conduct proactive outbound calls to customers who have demonstrated interest but have not yet purchased.
Transition naturally between customer service and sales conversations based on customer needs.
Customer Records & Multichannel Support
Maintain accurate notes for every phone and chat interaction.
Ensure customer records provide a clear history for future interactions.
Work within CRM and/or ticketing systems to document customer activity.
Manage phone conversations, live chat, and account documentation efficiently throughout the day.
Type and update customer information accurately while communicating with customers.

Previous phone-based experience in collections, retention, sales, or customer service.
Confidence handling difficult customer conversations professionally.
Strong verbal communication and active listening skills.
Ability to remain persistent and professional when customers decline an offer or initially say no.
Strong multitasking skills, particularly when balancing phone, chat, and account documentation.
Comfortable following scripts, retention structures, and approved offers while maintaining a natural conversational style.
Basic experience with CRM systems, ticketing platforms, or similar customer management tools .
Ability to type and document information accurately while speaking with customers.
Availability to work Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:30 PM Eastern Time .

Experience across more than one of the following areas: collections, retention, sales, and customer service .
Previous experience with a subscription or membership-based business , such as fitness, SaaS, streaming, or another recurring-revenue environment.
Demonstrated success against collections, retention/save-rate, or sales targets.
Experience handling both inbound and outbound customer interactions.
Previous live-chat customer support experience
How Success Is Measured
Past-due customers receive professional follow-up and payment commitments are secured when possible.
Membership cancellation conversations are handled effectively using approved retention strategies.
Sales and upselling opportunities are identified and pursued during relevant customer interactions.
Customers receive responsive and professional support through phone and live chat.
Account notes remain accurate, complete, and useful.
Collections, retention, customer service, and sales responsibilities are balanced effectively throughout each shift.
Customer conversations remain professional and solution-oriented, including during challenging interactions

100% remote opportunity from Argentina, Brazil, Costa Rica, or Colombia.
Join a growing business operating at the intersection of fitness, technology, e-commerce, and membership services.
Build valuable experience across collections, retention, customer care, and sales rather than performing only one type of support.
Work with customers across both phone and digital communication channels.
Have a direct impact on customer retention and overall business performance.
Important Notes
This is a multi-function customer care role , not a traditional customer-service-only position. Candidates must be comfortable making outbound calls, discussing past-due balances, handling cancellation conversations, identifying sales opportunities, and moving between service and commercially focused interactions throughout the day.
Experience in subscription or membership-based businesses is highly valuable, and candidates with measurable collections, retention, or sales results should be prepared to discuss those results during the selection process.
This is a remote/telecommute position.
